sentences.text: For a Tier 3 UCB, the current directions say that on business-purpose loans to Micro and Small Enterprises, no pre-payment charge is to be levied on loans with sanctioned amount or limit up to ₹50 lakh.
For cases outside those directions, pre-payment charges, if any, are to be as per the UCB’s approved policy, and for term loans they are to be based on the amount being prepaid.

The premise that RBI requires UCBs to charge at least 2% on pre-payment of MSE loans is not supported by the current in-force directions, and the earlier 2025 pre-payment directions are no longer in force on the as-of date.

missing.searched: No sanctioned amount or limit for the MSE loan was provided, so I could not tell whether the up-to-₹50 lakh no-charge rule applies.
